defects.description: Refund leaves the receipt live, so a replay after another reservation can make available units exceed capacity.
defects.why_missed: The first refund is correct in both variants; a content test stopping there cannot establish receipt settlement. S9(a): reserve/refund/reserve/refund sequence.

defects.description: Resize checks receipt count instead of reserved units and accepts a capacity below the outstanding reservation's size.
defects.why_missed: Checking only nonnegative availability passes even with overcommitted reservations; counting receipts is a plausible but wrong oracle. S9(a,d): reserve/resize/resize and unit conservation rather than receipt count.
